about: Golden questions for the trainee assistant (AI-05). Each answerable question names the source documents that answer it (help:<slug> is a help-centre article; program:<code> and lesson:<id> may be used for course content). Off-topic questions must be declined. tedc:ai-eval reports hit@3, hit@5, citation accuracy and refusal accuracy against the thresholds in Settings → AI.
